description: This file contains functions and logic related to managing sandbox runtime status, session handling, and tool policy enforcement within an OpenClaw project. It includes functions for resolving session keys, determining sandbox mode, and generating user-facing messages about sandbox tool policies.

methods.name: shouldSandboxSession
methods.description: Determines if a session should be sandboxed based on configuration mode and session keys.

methods.name: resolveMainSessionKeyForSandbox
methods.description: Resolves the main session key for a sandbox, considering global scope.

methods.name: resolveComparableSessionKeyForSandbox
methods.description: Generates a canonical session key for comparison purposes.

methods.name: resolveSandboxRuntimeStatus
methods.description: Main function to resolve the current sandbox runtime status, including agent ID, session keys, mode, and tool policy.

methods.name: sanitizeForSingleLineDisplay
methods.description: Sanitizes a string for single-line display by escaping control characters.

methods.name: hasUnsafeControlChars
methods.description: Checks if a string contains unsafe control characters.

methods.name: redactSessionKey
methods.description: Redacts a session key for display, showing only parts of it.

methods.name: shellEscapeSingleArg
methods.description: Escapes a string as a shell argument.

methods.name: formatSandboxToolPolicyBlockedMessage
methods.description: Generates a message explaining why a tool is blocked by sandbox policy, including fixes and instructions.
